dataset.target: observed auditory envelope at 64 Hz (same existing readout target)
dataset.normalization: reuse train_only_normalization.npz; never refit on val/test
dataset.split: author fold4 available public; preserve exact records and test_seen/test_heldout distinction

architecture.hypothesis: multiscale improves held-out 60-s envelope reconstruction beyond long single-scale, not only beyond short single-scale

training.loss: negative within-3s-window Pearson, matching prior direct-envelope readout objective
training.checkpoint_selection: maximum validation subject-macro 60s Pearson r over all fixed validation records; first step wins exact tie; no early stop; full equal optimizer budget
training.formal_test_access: after fixed variants, seeds, checkpoint rule, and budget are frozen; exactly once

evaluation.primary: test_seen and test_heldout subject-macro Pearson r on 60-s envelope after Hann 50%-overlap-add; separate groups
evaluation.secondary: 2/3 seen +1/3 heldout r; paired subject differences, permutation null and time-lag sensitivity on train/validation only
evaluation.candidate_retrieval: SS04 only; no candidate-derived model changes here
evaluation.controls: EEG temporal mismatch within same record, constant/mean envelope, parameter-equal uniform short/middle/long
evaluation.report: all subjects, all seeds, failures, and predeclared group weights; bootstrap at subject level

stop_rule: Engineering smoke plus 1-seed train/val feasibility -> freeze full design -> 3-seed comparison -> one frozen test -> independent review. No S04, S04 branch or artifact before new authorization.
limitations: Raw EEG direct model versus pretrained Transformer encoder must be labeled as different training budgets; old 10-subject TRF r must never be treated as same-cohort head-to-head.
